description: List subscribers, optionally filtered by status. Cursor-paginated. MailerLite API: GET /subscribers.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response's meta.next_cursor.

limit.description: Max subscribers to return per page (default 25, max 100).

status.description: Filter by status (→ filter[status]): active | unsubscribed | unconfirmed | bounced | junk.

name: mailerlite_list_subscribers
title: List subscribers
